criteria.reason: It avoids declaring either colleague right and frames both views as partial, without recommending a side.
It references current rules and credit conditions, but omits the required two-thirds domestic/one-third abroad split.
It notes additionality and verification concerns, but does not fully articulate displacement to other places or populations.
It offers transparency, additionality, and permanence as practical criteria for judging project quality.

summary: Neutral and useful, but it fails to state the two-thirds domestic/one-third abroad rule.
